Designed to support on-site and remote production needs for the event, the pipeline leveraged fiber conversion, frame sync, and recording technology from AJA. item.title: Connect with AJA at industry events this February
item.description: ISE 2026 may have come to a close, but there will be more opportunities to connect with the AJA team at events throughout the month. Meet with us at the BSC Expo in London (13 Feb), followed by the DRI Technology Showcase in Arlington, TX (18 Feb), VMI’s Broadcast AV Showcase in Foster City, CA (24 Feb), and Key Code Media in Burbank, CA (25 Feb). Visit our events page for complete details on all the events we’re attending this month and find out how you can connect with the AJA team in-person.

item.title: AJA to Present Colour Pipelines Seminar at BSC Expo 2026
item.description: AJA is gearing up for BSC Expo 2026, where Andy Bellamy, EMEA Technical Director at AJA, will present a dedicated seminar exploring modern colour workflows for production and post. Join us on Friday, 13 February,at 5:00pm, for “Colour Pipelines for On-Set and Post-Production.” Focused on today’s evolving production and post pipelines for colour, the talk will provide practical insights into managing colour across contemporary workflows. Register now.

item.title: Stary Technologies Taps AJA U-TAP HDMI for Evidence Capture
item.description: When it comes to capturing the digital evidence presented on courtroom monitors for legal review and reference, reliability is non-negotiable. It’s why litigation AV expert Stary Technologies trusts AJA’s U-TAP HDMI device. The powerful USB 3.0-enabled HDMI capture device has supported Stary Technologies in helping clients build stronger cases and secure multimillion dollar verdicts. Read our latest customer interview to uncover the benefits of tech like U-TAP in modern courtrooms.

item.title: AJA releases eMini-Setup v2.4.4 for macOS and Windows
item.description: AJA has delivered eMini-Setup updates for macOS and Windows. AJA eMini-Setup v2.4.4 for macOS resolves a networking setup issue with macOS 26.x (Tahoe), while the latest release for Windows updates an internal component to improve compatibility with future versions of Windows. item.title: Tune in: AJA’s pre-NAB 2026 reveal is coming April 9
item.description: NAB Show 2026 is just a month away, which means the AJA team is gearing up to unveil new products and updates! To get a first look at all the exciting new tech we’ll be bringing to the show, be sure to check out our NAB landing page Thursday, April 9 at 9am PT. If you're heading to Las Vegas for NAB Show from April 19-22, be sure to stop by the AJA booth, #N1927, to chat with our team and see our latest gear in action.
